summary: Help requests that include --json or --agent emit parseable command/flag JSON instead of Cobra's human help.
reason: Cobra renders help before PersistentPreRunE, so agent mode cannot rely on the normal --agent expansion path to switch help output into JSON.
validated_outcome: pages update --help --json and pages update --help --agent both parse with python3 -m json.tool while plain --help remains human-readable.
